newsitem.title: ITALY: Wanted mafioso arrested in Sicily.
newsitem.headline: Wanted mafioso arrested in Sicily.

text.p: Giuseppe Mangion, believed to be one of the biggest drug traffickers operating out of the east of Sicily, has been arrested, police said on Thursday.
Mangion has been on the run since 1992 and was finally seized in a police operation late on Wednesday.
Mafia turncoats said 47-year old Mangion was one of the last members of the once-powerful Santapaola mob clan to have escaped death or capture.
Boss Nitto Santapaolo is currently in prison, along with one of his closest allies -- Mangion's brother, Francesco.
